name: Apricot almond fudge
author: The Wickham family

ingredients.item: 2 pkts biscuits, plain or coconut flavoured, crushed finely

steps: Place the butter, sugar and condensed milk in a large heatproof microwave bowl and cover loosely.
Microwave on 100% power for 4 minutes, stirring well every minute.
Alternatively boil for 2 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent catching.
Remove from the microwave and mix in all other ingredients.
Press the mixture into a sponge roll tin and chill for about 20 minutes before icing.
To ice combine 50g soft butter and 300g icing sugar with enough water to make a spreadable icing.
Mix in 1 teaspoon of vanilla and a dash of almond essence.
Spread over the slice and dot with sliced toasted almonds.
Chill until icing has set then cut into bite sized squares.
